verdict.rationale: There is no official n8n or Zapier connector in the evidence. Integration relies on the Dockerized FastAPI server (crawl4ai-gh-5), which a developer can call over HTTP from an automation platform. A third-party community hub offers one-click Docker setups for n8n (crawl4ai-comm-6), and a community member notes that new developers often struggle to bridge Crawl4AI with n8n (crawl4ai-comm-5). Missing for 10: an official prebuilt n8n or Zapier connector, first-party integration docs, any Zapier support, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes return 404).
